author: nixo.eth
content:
some agenda items to highlight ahead of this coming ACDE:

- We have one more PFI EIP to get through: [EIP-7907](<https://forkcast.org/eips/7907/>) - this was [just added last ACDE](<https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/247/?summary=notes#t=2649>). I've asked all EL client teams to please come to Thursday with an opinion on it <:pepepray:948648134601502791>
- There are three slots that look good for a mainnet fork. even if we don't set it until after a successful Hoodi, worth thinking about if y'all have a preference (all shown in your local timezone):
  - <t:1796157480:F> (slot: 15777792)
  - <t:1796747340:F> (slot: 15826944)
  - <t:1796845620:F> (slot: 15835136)
- I'm working with STEEL & the Pandas right now to come up with a CFI EIP priority list (from [EIP 7723](<https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7723#considered-for-inclusion>): "facilitators should work with the testing teams to propose a priority ordering of CFI EIPs to be reviewed by client developers") - it would help inform the ordering of EIPs going into devnets, will bring it to ACDE. TBD if it'll include CL EIPs since they're not finished scoping
- <@415548822983278593> will be running this call \:)
